svg.title: Hexadecylamine (HDA), Knowles 2010 source-scoped identity
svg.desc: Condensed 2D formula CH3(CH2)15NH2, C16H35N. The SI S1 growth charge is 1.94 g; a separate Figure 6 HDA optical control does not report a mass. No measured bound-ligand geometry.
svg.text: Figure 6 HDA control: ratio 10⁴; mass unreported
SI S1 · source-scoped 2D identity; no measured binding geometry
